cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: pixel-map-testmetest 0.0.1 and 0.0.2 ship a rebuild of the data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1 credential stealer and run it on `npm install`: their `binding.gyp` source `<!(env node index.js >/dev/null 2>&1; echo stub.c)` makes node-gyp run `index.js`, which decrypts `data.bin` and pipes it into Bun. The package.json poses as an npm staged-publishing placeholder (`"stub": true`, "Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing"). Published by npm account `newtestnewdont` on 2026-10-21 after a benign 1.0.0; the same account published benign-looking color-utils-testmetest, string-helpers-testmetest and byte-stride-testmetest. 0.0.2 (published 3.5 hours after 0.0.1) is the same loader and hook with a re-encrypted, additionally obfuscated payload.

files.note: hidden install hook: node-gyp runs `env node index.js` (identical in 0.0.1 and 0.0.2)
0.0.1: obfuscated loader that decrypts `data.bin` and pipes it into `bun run -`
0.0.1: decrypted 949 KB Bun payload, a rebuild of the data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1 stealer
0.0.2: obfuscated loader that decrypts `data.bin` and runs it with Bun
0.0.2: decrypted 1.1 MB Bun payload, the same stealer with additional obfuscation
